newsitem.title: USA: IBM solidy on track for Q2 -- SoundView.
newsitem.headline: IBM solidy on track for Q2 -- SoundView.

text.p: SoundView Financial analyst Gary Helmig reiterated a buy rating on International Business Machines Corp, saying IBM is "solidly on track for the quarter" despite recent earnings warnings from other technology companies.
"PCs are still very strong, hard disk drives are sold out, the mainframe disk storage based on Iceberg is sold out," Helmig said. "I think they are solidly on track for the quarter."
He said AS/400 minicomputers and RS/6000 workstations were "drifting along," as expected, but that North America would have a very strong finish in June, especially with the new mainframes shipping.
Helmig said there is a lot of money floating into the stock market and that IBM is a good place for investors.
He said his second quarter earnings estimate for IBM is $1.42 a share. The Wall Street consensus estimate is also $1.42.
IBM shares were up 1-7/8 to 91-5/8 in active trading.
